verdict.rationale: Tensor throughput is a fair question for a GPU, but the evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures, let alone ones broken out by precision or sparsity. It only says there is a second-generation FP8 Transformer Engine and touts 96 GB of memory. A community anecdote of 41k tok/s on a four-card rig is a workload result, not a stated tensor-throughput spec, so it cannot be used to size training or inference.
